CustomField.description: The GitHub login of the person who approved the glassops-deploy environment for this production deploy run. Blank when the run was not deployed through GlassOps or no approval is on record. Copied from the governance event.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Set by the deploy workflow from the run's approvals. Blank when GlassOps did not deploy the run.
CustomField.label: Approver
